description_en: Pay-as-you-go instances are billed based on the actual usage of purchased resource specifications. You use resources first and then pay for them. This billing method is suitable for testing or short-term scenarios with unpredictable traffic peaks. This topic describes how to call CreatePostPayOrder to create a pay-as-you-go instance
description_zh: 后付费实例根据所购资源规格的实际使用量计费，先使用，后计费。主要适用于测试或者流量峰值不确定的短期场景。本文介绍如何调用CreatePostPayOrder创建后付费实例
name: CreatePostPayOrder

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

0: premium cloud disk

1: SSD
If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘类型。取值：

0：高效云盘

1：SSD
若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk capacity.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.
If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘容量。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。
若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

4: Internet- and VPC-connected instance

5: VPC-connected instance
parameters.help_zh:
部署类型。取值：

4：公网/VPC实例

5：VPC实例
parameters.name: deploy_type

parameters.help_en:
The Internet traffic.

If DeployType is set to 4, this parameter is required.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
公网流量。

如果DeployType为4，则需填写。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: eip_max

parameters.help_en:
The maximum traffic (not recommended).

You must specify one of IoMax and IoMaxSpec. If both parameters are specified, the value of IoMaxSpec takes precedence. Specify only IoMaxSpec.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
流量峰值（不推荐）。

流量峰值和流量规格必须选填一个。同时填写时，以流量规格为准。建议您只填写流量规格。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: io_max

parameters.help_en:
The number of partitions (recommended).

You must specify one of PartitionNum and TopicQuota. Specify only PartitionNum.

If both PartitionNum and TopicQuota are specified, the system verifies whether the values are equivalent based on the legacy topic sales model. If the values are not equivalent, the request fails. If the values are equivalent, the purchase is made based on the number of partitions.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
分区数（推荐）。

分区数和Topic规格必须选填一个，建议您只填写分区数。

分区数和Topic规格同时填写时，将会按照老的Topic售卖模型去校验分区数和Topic规格是否等价：如不等价将返回失败；如等价则按分区数进行购买。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: partition_num

parameters.help_en:
The number of topics (not recommended).

You must specify one of PartitionNum and TopicQuota. Specify only PartitionNum.

If both PartitionNum and TopicQuota are specified, the system verifies whether the values are equivalent based on the legacy topic sales model. If the values are not equivalent, the request fails. If the values are equivalent, the purchase is made based on the number of partitions.

The default value varies based on the traffic specification. If the value exceeds the default value, additional fees are charged.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
Topic的数量（不推荐）。

分区数和Topic规格必须选填一个，建议您只填写分区数。

分区数和Topic规格同时填写时，将会按照老的Topic售卖模型去校验分区数和Topic规格是否等价：如不等价将返回失败；如等价则按分区数进行购买。

流量规格不同，默认值不同。超过默认值，需额外收费。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: topic_quota

parameters.help_en:
The billing type. Valid values:

1 (default): reserved instance with pay-as-you-go billing.
3: serverless instance with reserved specification pay-as-you-go billing + serverless elastic scaling pay-as-you-go billing
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：

1（默认）：预留实例后付费。
3：Serverless实例预留规格后付费+Serverless弹性伸缩后付费
parameters.name: paid_type

parameters.help_en:
The specification type.

Valid values when PaidType is set to 1 (reserved instance with pay-as-you-go billing):

normal: Standard Edition (shared throughput for writes)
professional: Professional Edition (shared throughput for writes)
professionalForHighRead: Professional Edition (shared throughput for reads)

Valid values when PaidType is set to 3 (serverless instance with reserved specification pay-as-you-go billing + serverless elastic scaling pay-as-you-go billing):

basic: Serverless Basic Edition
normal: Serverless Standard Edition
professional: Serverless Professional Edition

For more information about these specification types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html
parameters.help_zh:
规格类型。

当PaidType参数为1（预留实例后付费）时取值：

normal：标准版（高写版）
professional：专业版（高写版）
professionalForHighRead：专业版（高读版）

当PaidType参数为3（Serverless实例预留规格后付费+Serverless弹性伸缩后付费）时取值：

basic：Serverless基础版
normal：Serverless标准版
professional：Serverless专业版

以上规格类型的说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html
parameters.name: spec_type

parameters.help_en:
The traffic specification (recommended).

You must specify one of IoMax and IoMaxSpec. If both parameters are specified, the value of IoMaxSpec takes precedence. Specify only IoMaxSpec.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

If you create a serverless instance, you do not need to set this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
流量规格（推荐）。

流量峰值和流量规格必须选填一个。同时填写时，以流量规格为准。建议您只填写流量规格。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: io_max_spec

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

If this parameter is not specified, the instance is placed in the default resource group. You can view the resource group ID in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

不设置时落在默认资源组里，可在资源组控制台查看资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.
N ranges from 1 to 20.
If this parameter is left empty, all tag keys are matched.
The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。
N为1~20。
如果为空，则匹配所有标签键。
最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.
N ranges from 1 to 20.
If the tag key is left empty, this parameter must also be left empty. If this parameter is left empty, all tag values are matched.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。
N为1~20。
如果标签键为空，则必须为空。为空时，匹配所有标签值。
最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The reserved publish traffic specification value. Only integers are supported. The minimum value is 60. This parameter is required for serverless instances.


The actual upper limit depends on the inventory in the current region. Refer to the purchase page for the available range
fields.help_zh:
预留的发送流量规格值，仅支持传入整数，最低 60。Serverless 实例必传。


实际上限受当前地域库存影响，请参考售卖页可选范围
fields.name: reserved_publish_capacity

fields.help_en:
The reserved subscribe traffic specification value. Only integers are supported. The minimum value is 20. This parameter is required for serverless instances.

The actual upper limit depends on the inventory in the current region. Refer to the purchase page for the available range
fields.help_zh:
预留的消费流量规格值，仅支持传入整数，最低 20。Serverless 实例必传。

实际上限受当前地域库存影响，请参考售卖页可选范围
fields.name: reserved_subscribe_capacity
